Customs

การยื่นศุลกากร

The formal submission of required documentation and data to customs authorities for the clearance, import, or export of goods, as mandated by law or regulation.

Quick answer: The formal submission of required documentation and data to customs authorities for the clearance, import, or export of goods, as mandated by law or regulation.

This term page is part of the Protermify Logistics glossary and is published as static HTML for fast indexing and clear language coverage.

Quick answer

The formal submission of required documentation and data to customs authorities for the clearance, import, or export of goods, as mandated by law or regulation.

Why it matters

การยื่นศุลกากร matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is การยื่นศุลกากร?

In this glossary, การยื่นศุลกากร refers to: The formal submission of required documentation and data to customs authorities for the clearance, import, or export of goods, as mandated by law or regulation.

How is การยื่นศุลกากร used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "ต้องยื่นศุลกากรอย่างถูกต้องสำหรับสินค้านำเข้าทุกประเภทเพื่อความถูกต้องและป้องกันความล่าช้า"

Why does การยื่นศุลกากร matter in logistics?

การยื่นศุลกากร matters because it supports clear communication in Customs contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses การยื่นศุลกากร?

การยื่นศุลกากร is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does การยื่นศุลกากร belong to?

In this glossary, การยื่นศุลกากร is grouped under Customs. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The formal submission of required documentation and data to customs authorities for the clearance, import, or export of goods, as mandated by law or regulation.

Operational example

Accurate customs filing is required for all imports to ensure compliance and prevent shipment delays.
